profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Grainger
profile.summary:
As a developer and principal, I’ve been entrusted with brands such as T-Mobile, American Airlines, Virgin Atlantic, AllState, Gogo, Delta Airlines, Berkshire Hathaway, Jones Lang LaSalle, Martin Brower, Navistar, OfficeMax.

With the experience of working over 60 sites and applications, it is my goal to design and develop a product that will give users a smooth user experience no matter what platform they’re using. 


/// SKILL_SET
:: Custom Salesforce integration
:: Elixir
:: RxJS/React/Redux
:: Ionic 3/4
:: Firebase Hosting
:: Firebase Cloud Functions
:: Firebase Firestore
:: Angular 4
:: Cypress Integration testing
:: HTML5/CSS3/Mustache/Handlebars
:: Less/Sass
:: Backbone/Marionette
:: Grunt/Gulp/Bower/Webpack
:: Ampersand
:: HTML Emails/Responsive Design
:: Vanilla JS/jQuery/JSON/P 
:: Cross Browser Development
:: Wordpress Development
:: Art Direction
:: UX, Wireframing
:: Canvas/SVG animations

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led and mentored during the modernization of the new Checkout Experience
- Led and mentored during the modernization of the Cart Experience

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Led and developed AWS Eventbridge, SQS, Salesforce event relay integration to communicate with our microservice applications.
- Coordinated with PM to have AC written in Gherkin statements that translated into statements in our Cypress tests that are used for the QA process.
- Led team to deploy 8 key business features and broke down the requirements into consumable and predictable stories to execute and plan for the future

positions.title: Senior Front End Engineer
positions.description:
- Pioneered accessibility on-commit checks and fixed over 400 a11y issues in app that otherwise would not have been addressed
- Integrated 100+ Mixpanel events to help product team keep track of what isoccurring in app
- Created over 10 storybook components to document shared components

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
- Launched application into production using Google Hosting, Firebase DB and creating APIs through Google cloud functions.
- Architected, designed and developed Texas Hold Em game using React/Redux/Firebase DB that has been used and played by users in over 15 countries around the world.

positions.title: President
positions.description: - I've helped, and worked with companies such as Jones Lang LaSalle, ALG Worldwide, Global Network Security, Navistar, OfficeMax, Gerard Design, Frey Designs On The Katwalk, Plan B, and Donna Vock Designs to create experiences that user's will remember.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Developer
positions.description:
- Led React development of payment application that integrated with airline partner programs.
- Created over 50+ React/Enzyme unit tests for our applications
- Established creation of Cypress.js tests to automate production tests and speed up deployments
- Implemented production deployment processes that reduced new customer facing bugs by over 50%
- Collaborating and overseeing transition of Backbone applications to React/Redux.
- Originated documentation that allows any developer to visually see how a feature requirement works and where to find code in repositories.
- Developed over 40 different components/pages/services that are reusable between 4 different products, and over 12 different airlines.
- Transitioned over 10 customer facing JSP applications into one single reusable and extendable Backbone SPA application.

positions.title: Lead Front-End Application Developer
positions.description:
- Originated first time use of version control of company’s front end code base using GIT and Gitflow branching model.
- Implemented first time use of Gulp/Mustache/LESS into our processes for a quicker turnaround.
- Worked directly with Product Managers and VPs to complete over 250 business requirements across 3 main products.
- Created front end architecture and led development of Delta Airlines’ interface (our largest client). Turnaround time for the project was 4 months, and it was released into production with 0 bugs.
- Created a custom php application that allowed reusable HTML snippets to output unique HTML files for product to view, and java engineers to use in jsp.
- Oversaw and groomed contractors and junior developers into our environment

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
- Fixed over 70 bugs for the life of the video product and over 30 bugs for other teams.
- Reduced the size of the video product by 45% by removing redundant code and enabling gzip compression.
- Introduced correct HTML/CSS methodologies into video application that allowed the product to work responsively across all devices/browsers supported.

positions.title: Eloqua Developer
positions.description:
-Developed over 10 reusable email marketing email designs.
-Programmed over 15 different email automation campaigns filtering through data to target different client groups.

positions.title: Freelance
positions.description: - Cut up several website's that required unique features to display on the web appropriately, involving CSS, Javascript, HTML and Flash. Worked with Jason Frey and Lisa Tomasino-Glawe.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description: - Worked as a Front-End Developer that included: cutting up 14+ microsites and websites; cutting up 20+ html emails that were sent through either Campaign Monitor or Outlook; design and media queries for 4 mobile websites/presentations, and general maintenance for client's websites. These companies include OfficeMax, Navman Wireless, and Navistar.
